events.body: DL-5280: we hold label data received 24 Dec 23:47 and no physical scan of any kind. No collection scan, no hub scan. We gather a merchant agent has told the customer a ten-day carrier investigation is needed. Nobody has opened one with us, and we would not open a trace on a parcel with no acceptance scan unless the merchant's warehouse confirms it was handed to our driver and gives the collection manifest number.

Ordered a recliner on 21 December. Label 'created' that night and the tracking has not moved ONE line in thirteen days. Agent one, 29 Dec: put me on hold and hung up. Agent two, 31 Dec: 'I can see the carrier has collected it.' Collected it to where? Agent three, 2 Jan: 'that will need a ten day investigation with the carrier.' Then a supervisor, same day, says actually she'll 'ask the warehouse if it even shipped' and ring me back. That was Saturday. Nothing. Four people, four different stories, and my dad is sleeping propped up on the sofa after his operation because the chair he's meant to be recovering in is God knows where. You're the delivery desk. Open the trace with Sedgemoor Arc today and find it.

TG-6227 / DL-5280, recliner, label generated 24 Dec 23:47, your last status 'awaiting pick'. Please confirm from your own record whether this was physically picked and handed to a Sedgemoor Arc driver. If it was, I need the date and the collection manifest number, because Sedgemoor Arc's Parcel trace team hold label data only, with no collection or hub scan, and will not open a trace without it. If it was not, please say where it is now. One of your phone agents told the customer on 28 December that the carrier had collected it, which the Refunds team says was a misreading of the label line, so the two accounts conflict and only your record settles it. The customer has had four different answers since 26 December and a supervisor's callback promised on 31 December has not come. The chair is for his father, who is recovering from an operation. Please treat it as urgent.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.
